**Instructions:**

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a record disappears from the selected Insightly object type (Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Organization, Project, Task, Event, Product, or Quote), inferring deletion by polling and comparing against previously seen records. Requires the Insightly pod (e.g. "na1") matching your account region.
